topic: The Engine of Intelligence: Understanding Cost Functions and Gradient Descent
target_audience: Undergraduate students with basic knowledge of functions and derivatives

sections.title: The Objective: Defining the 'Error'
lecture_lines: The Cost Function measures prediction error.
It acts as a scoreboard for AI.
animations: Draw a graph representing a error function in #00FF00.
Draw a dashed line connecting Predicted and Actual in #FFFF00.
Display [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/scoreboard.svg] to show the current error score.

sections.title: The Landscape of Loss
lecture_lines: Weights are coordinates on this map.
Bottom of the valley is perfect accuracy.
animations: Display text 'The Landscape of Loss' in #FFFFFF.
Render a 3D surface mesh in #00FFFF, styled to resemble the topography of a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/mountain.svg].
Place a moving dot representing weights on the surface #FFFF00, traversing from the peak down into the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/valley.svg].

sections.title: The Gradient Descent Algorithm
lecture_lines: Gradient Descent helps reach the valley.
Feel the ground to find downward slopes.
animations: Highlight the slope gradient vector on [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/mountain.svg] in #FF0000.
Animate [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/hiker.svg] making a descent step along the negative gradient #00FF00.

sections.title: Learning Rate: The Size of the Step
lecture_lines: Large steps might overshoot the valley.
animations: Display a large arrow overshoot in #FF0000.
Display a small optimized step at the bottom in #00FF00 [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/valley.svg].

sections.title: Conclusion and Feedback Loop
lecture_lines: This cycle is how machines learn.
animations: Show a circular flowchart with arrows in #00FFFF, featuring the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/machine.svg] at the center.
